source_arguments.argument: One producer issues both B logical boxes before the next iteration. The next same-slot acquire waits the previous generation empty completion, not previous full completion.
q0 has no normal release. After commit(q), wait1 retires previous groups and release emits for q-1. Per-thread loop order lifts to necessary inequalities between max-all events.
MMA order arrival follows mma return and precedes mma_tail. Tail wait0 additionally drains the last group, then releases it. Older group retirements are already transitive prerequisites.

Producer tail follows final submissions and serially checks the six persistent empty states. Earlier releases are prerequisites of subsequent same-slot acquisitions; latest six are explicit tail waits.

event_contracts: Consumer *_all means maximum over128 corresponding thread events; max(A_i)<=max(B_i) follows per-thread A_i<=B_i. It does not mean every thread waits for the global maximum.

release_emit_all denotes the last actual empty-arrival emission, not a consumer_release_post observation. Empty completion may precede such a post marker, so that substitution would not preserve the edge.
mma_retired is the logical completion obligation of a committed WGMMA group, not an isolated TensorCore service timestamp.
MMA order and epilogue order are separate sequence stages. No prior-output tail or final D-store edge is added to the next output first MMA without its own source dependency.
